_comment: Section-scoped analyte-name aliases applied at the catalog/aggregation layer (Ruby upsert_analyte + JS aggregate.js). The parser itself now stitches within-report line-wrapped names (e.g. 'Blood /' + 'Hemoglobin' -> 'Blood / Hemoglobin', 'White Blood' + 'Cells' -> 'White Blood Cells'), so these aliases now serve two remaining purposes: (1) reconcile genuine cross-report naming/spelling differences that are NOT wraps ('% Reticulocyte' vs '% Reticulocytes', '... Zinc Sulfate' vs '... Zinc Sulfate Centrifugation', 'Collection' vs 'Collection Method'); and (2) act as a fallback that keeps already-stored browser data (parsed before the stitch fix, not yet reprocessed) unified. The wrap-fragment rules below are now redundant with the parser but kept as that safety net.
